title: LimeSpot Personalizer - Shopify AI personalization app
clean_text: LimeSpot Personalizer is an AI personalization platform offering product recommendations, Frequently Bought Together suggestions, upsell and cross-sell bundles, A/B testing, email and SMS personalization, and customer segmentation. The platform integrates with Shopify, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Maropost, Magento, and WooCommerce.
